ai_summary: Apoorva Leasing Finance & Investment Co. Ltd.'s statutory auditors, M/s Singhal & Gupta, have resigned with immediate effect, citing "commercial considerations and changes in professional priorities" well before their scheduled term expiration in 2028. Although the auditors explicitly deny any other material reasons, inability to obtain sufficient audit evidence, or raising concerns, an early resignation of statutory auditors inherently presents a red flag for investors regarding potential underlying issues or future financial reporting stability.
